thesis: The episode introduces Roxton McNeil, head of multi-asset investment strategy and allocation at the UPS Investment Trust, who previously worked in CTAs, developed hedge models for Bonnie Light Oil, and managed asset liability at General Motors. The conversation explores how the constraints and realities of liability-driven investing shape views on hot button institutional issues such as glide paths, private investing, tactical asset allocation, and tail risk hedging.
